notes: Size 7" from the frame size in the model name (the datasheet doesn't state it). Xmax 3 mm is half the published linear coil travel (6 mm peak to peak). Mms 14.12 g is the published moving mass plus air load (13.3 + 0.82 g). Coaxial: the woofer's parameters (the tweeter's are left out).
